order: rotate P1/P4 per rep, alternate arms per rep+cell

criteria.purpose: recommend next adoption investigation; not product acceptance
criteria.correctness: all positive SQL/cleanup and negative oracle controls pass
criteria.fork: paired median process child-Fork p50 improvement >=3% and >=4/5 pairs improve in each P1/P4 cell
criteria.guards: paired median CPU, Fork-to-first-SELECT and full-suite <=+5%; report every pair; >=4/5 pairs worse by >5% is sustained regression
criteria.memory: paired median total held RSS including image cache <=+10% for hold1/4; also report pre-root and baseline deltas
criteria.tails: keep all children and runs; p95 and >100ms per stage; no #68 reopening

boundaries: root Start includes initial image construction
memory is separate process current ps RSS; forced GC equally at checkpoints; not PSS or physical sharing
P1 fork CPU only; P4 process CPU not per-child exclusive
